description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to image styling, including responsive images and retina images, used for styling images in web projects.

methods.name: img-responsive
methods.description: Mixin to ensure images scale responsively within their parent container without exceeding its width.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin for setting background images optimized for retina displays, including media queries for high pixel density screens.
